rfam.comment: RNA-guided Streptococcus pyogenes Cas9 (SpCas9) is a sequence-specific DNA endonuclease, the Trans-activating CRISPR RNA form an hybrid with the crRNA (crRNA/tracrRNA). The RNA hybrid acts as a guide for the endonuclease Cas9 [1,2]. The tracrRNA component structure has been reported in PDB: 6MCB and 7V59 [3,4]
